metadata.label: Shape model
metadata.coverage: Illustrative scale model of the published Jacobi fit: b/a=0.60, c/b=0.72, scaled to the paper’s adopted approximate 700 km volume-equivalent diameter. These smooth axes are inferred, not resolved terrain. Uses one published pole interpretation, ecliptic longitude 53° ±10° and latitude −64° ±6°, converted with the J2000 mean obliquity for display. The antipodal pole is also allowed; equinox and meridian are display conventions, not a qualified absolute attitude. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
